plainName: Stops, glides and C-cuts, three zones
description: A review day from Lesson 4. Groups move to the next zone on the whistle: the one o’clock–eleven o’clock stop as a stop-light game, arm-pump glides, and alternating C-cuts.
steps: A: skate on green, glide on yellow, stop on red.
B: pump your arms, then glide as far as you can.
C: push alternating C-cuts down the strip.
cues: Green go, yellow glide, red stop!
Pump your arms, glide like a rocket.

zones.name: Stop lights
zones.how: Line up on the goal line. Green: skate. Yellow: glide. Red: stop on one skate, the turned foot pushing snow. Cross the zone with several stops, then come back stopping on the other foot.
zones.cue: Green go, yellow glide, red stop!

zones.name: Rocket glides
zones.how: Line up on the goal line. Pump your arms to get going, then glide as far as you can on two skates.
zones.cue: Pump your arms, glide like a rocket.

zones.name: C-cut zigzag
zones.how: Push C shapes with one foot, then the other, bringing each foot back under you before the next push.

source.label: Hockey Canada U7 Lesson 4 · 1.3.06, 1.1.05, 1.4.02
source.note: Lesson 4 introduces nothing new: it reviews Lesson 3. We kept the stops, arm-pump glides and alternating C-cuts; striding, glide turns and edge control are in Race Cars.
